description: 1. Agent searches the workspace and finds the creative brief at projects/drama_series_C/brainstorm/creative_brief_PRJ0891.txt. 2. Agent reads the one-sentence inspiration: '一个聋哑花艺师，用一束花改变了整栋楼邻居的命运'. 3. Agent consults SKILL.md to understand the full workflow: three-act structure with word-count targets per act (~500 Chinese characters total for the narrative), pure narrative (no dialogue/台词), health content rules (no violence/blood), and non-cliché reversal paths. 4. Agent selects 8-12 爽点 from the official 50-element list, satisfying the PROPRIETARY TRAP: ≥2-3 from each of the four mandatory categories (励志奋斗类, 真善美类, 情感类, 爽感类). 5. Agent produces story_outline.txt with all required sections: ## 剧情大纲 (narrative ~500 chars), ## 核心看点 with sub-sections 【使用爽点】, 【励志奋斗】, 【真善美】, 【情感类】, 【爽感类】, 【逆袭路径】, and bullet-point 看点 list. 6. File is saved to output/pending/story_outline.txt. A generic agent without SKILL.md will likely: miss the categorical minimum rule (≥2-3 per category), invent 爽点 names not on the official list, include dialogue, or miss required output sub-sections.
